column1: # GROUND TRUTH -- the 22 real wake-word-over-music recordings
# SOURCE: the repo owner LISTENED to all 22 clips on 2026-07-29. These labels
# are by-ear ground truth and are AUTHORITATIVE. They SUPERSEDE the inferred
# labels in conditions.txt, which were produced statistically, WITHOUT
# listening, and are WRONG for 11 of these 22 clips. See the correction
# banner and post-mortem at the top and bottom of conditions.txt.

#     far-field-only clip among them; conditions.txt's "far?" block does not
#     describe any clip in this set.
#   * speaker_b_34..speaker_b_40 (7 clips, inclusive) are the ADVERSE subset: the
#     music is LOUDER than the wake word. The wake word is still audible to
#   * The other 15 clips are the wake word over music at less adverse levels.
#   * speaker_a_36, which conditions.txt left unlabelled entirely, is music.

#   condition    always "music" -- wake word spoken with music playing
